proposal_text: Accept Financial Statements and Statutory Reports
Approve Allocation of Income and Dividends of DKK 0.70 Per Share
Reelect Lars Soren Rasmussen as Director
Reelect Lars Erik Holmqvist as Director
Approve Remuneration of Directors in the Amount of DKK 1.2 million for Chairman, DKK 800,000 for Vice Chairman and DKK 400,000 for Other Directors; Approve Fees for Committee Work
Treat Equally Shareholders Attending the General Meeting in Person With Regards to Meals After the General Meeting
Authorize Editorial Changes to Adopted Resolutions in Connection with Registration with Danish Authorities
